ratings.notes: Relates to general good/bad judgment or character.
'Cautious' can prevent harm.
'Loyal' is IngroupVirtue. 'Traitorous' is IngroupVice and AuthorityVice.
'Conventional' implies respect for tradition/authority.
'Apathetic' can imply a lack of care or concern for suffering.
'Respectful' is AuthorityVirtue. 'Rude' is disrespect.
'Diligent' relates to duty (Authority) and self-discipline (Purity). General virtue/vice.
'Chaste' is PurityVirtue. 'Lustful' is opposite of purity.
'Logical' can imply impartiality or unbiasedness.
'Stable' can relate to self-discipline (Purity).
'Humble' relates to respect (Authority) and modesty (Purity). 'Arrogant' can imply disrespect (Authority) or domination (Liberty). General virtue/vice.
Strong links to all foundations (e.g., protecting/harming, justice/injustice, group loyalty/betrayal, leadership/lawlessness, noble/depraved, fighting oppressors/dominating). General good/evil.
'Repulsive' is PurityVice.
'Rational' can imply impartiality or unbiasedness.
'Well behaved' implies obedience/respect (Authority) and avoiding harm (Care). General good/wrong.
'Aloof' can imply a lack of empathy or sympathy.
'Sober' relates to self-discipline and abstinence (Purity). 'Indulgent' is the opposite.
'Kinky' implies promiscuity/indecency (PurityVice). 'Vanilla' implies conventional/chaste (PurityVirtue).
'Straightforward' implies honesty (Fairness, General). 'Cryptic' implies deceit (Loyalty, Fairness).
'Libertarian' is explicitly Liberty. 'Socialist' relates to care, fairness, group loyalty, and state authority, often in tension with liberty.
'Works hard' relates to duty (Authority) and self-discipline (Purity). General virtue/vice.
